//: Example aidb config. Copy to ~/.aidbrc (user-wide) or ./.aidb.json (per-project).
//load: Both files are JSON; project wins over ~/.aidbrc wins over defaults. A value that is malformed or out of range is reported and dropped, never fatal. `/config` prints the effective config + provenance, `/config reload` re-applies it live.

theme.//f: ANSI SGR colour codes (0-256). Roles: accent, muted, success, warning, error, border.

gdb.//f: path + env are honoured by the DAP client; extra gdb argv is reserved (core hardcodes --interpreter=dap --nx --quiet).

keybindings.//f: actions: continue stepOver stepInto stepOut scrollUp scrollDown. Each is an array of chord strings.
keybindings.//editor: pi-tui built-in keybinding overrides; the editor reads these live.

defaults.//f: Reserved placeholders for command defaults (break style, step behavior).

sessions.//f: historyPath is persisted across runs. sessionDir is reserved for full session snapshots.

windows.//f: Reserved: layout presets, manifest dir, refresh policy. Parsed but unused.

agent.//f: Reserved: tool permissions, approval gates. Parsed but unused.
